title: See Your Real AI Cost in One Command
pain_point: Solo founders and technical leads cannot reliably see AI coding usage and cost from one factual command.
story: Show an isolated demo usage ledger, run the real sdtk usage command, and explain only values visible in the output.
product_proof: Run the real sdtk usage command against an isolated DEMO DATA fixture and show its factual terminal output without inferred savings or unsupported cost claims.
source_boundaries: Use a dedicated demo HOME and never expose operator usage telemetry.

capture_contract.instruction: Run sdtk-marketing video terminal-capture run with the governed delegate and the exact approved sdtk usage argv in an isolated DEMO DATA fixture. Record a Playwright terminal composite labelled COMPOSITED FROM REAL COMMAND OUTPUT.
